distractors.text_hint: someone's new car in the car park
finished the repair on the pop valve last night

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Right, Thursday. Everyone awake, more or less?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: More or less. Whose new car is that in the car park? The shiny one taking up about a space and a half.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with more mud than paint.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Looks like it's only just come out of the showroom. Brave bringing it here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Give it a week. It'll match the rest.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, car reviews later. Think we've got all eight of us.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Can you hear me? Teams has picked the wrong microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, you're coming through. Bit hollow, but we can hear you.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's probably just me, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Ha. Marc, anything from last night before we get into the updates?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, finished the repair on the pop valve last night. That's sorted.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Ah, good stuff.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. Dave, where are you with yours?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: The pressure-drop investigation, I've boxed that off. All done.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, thanks.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I'm not chasing that purchase order now. The other shift already sorted it, so that chase is cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Fair enough. No point two shifts doing the same chase.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Hannah, how about you?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Um, the near-miss write-up's blocked. Waiting on the permit to be signed, so I can't take it any further.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Frustrating, that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah. On my pressure-drop investigation, I've done the prep; just the write-up left.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Saz asked me to pass on the sensor recalibration on the line 1 mould temp. She's still on it, going fine so far.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marc. Wasn't sure I'd get on the call when we spoke.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And my purchase-order chase is done. All signed off.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Lovely. Right, today's new bits, then.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Hannah Price, can you swap the filter on the cooling tower at half two? No rush.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll swap it at half two.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. It's not an urgent one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's fine with me.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, I talked over the end there. Only said okay.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No worries. I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team by 11am. No rush on that either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Cal. Happy with that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Nothing elaborate, just a toolbox talk.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: So not forty slides and a motivational video?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: You've ruined the surprise now.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, so I'll sort the training records for the new starters as well. No rush on those.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Marc.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Honestly, feels like there's more paperwork to being new than actually being new.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: You stop being new just as you learn where everything lives.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sounds about right. Mide, you were about to come in?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah. I'll go to the sub to pick up the replacement parts for the counterbalances after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks, Mide. Top priority please, that one.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Understood. I'll make that my top priority after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Actual parts collection, not your scenic tour past the coffee machine.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: One time, Jamie. You've had about six months out of that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: That's pretty good value for a coffee, to be fair.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a full review of everyone's breaks—any other new work to raise?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing else from me.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, nothing from electrical.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Nothing else here.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No more from me either. All clear on what's been agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay, that's everyone, then.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Still reckon that car belongs to a visitor. Nobody here keeps anything that clean.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Speak for yourself. I washed mine. Once.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: On that impressive note, we'll leave it there. Cheers, everyone.
